title: Purair® FUMEBOX™ - Portable Ductless Fume Adsorber for Chemical Manipulation
meta_title: Purair FUMEBOX - Portable Ductless Fume Adsorber for Chemical Manipulation
meta_description: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is a compact, portable ductless fume adsorber designed to protect users from chemicals, vapors, or non-toxic powders during low-volume chemical manipulations.
meta_keywords: ductless fume adsorber, portable fume hood, chemical manipulation safety, low-volume chemical containment
short_description: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is designed to protect the user from chemicals, vapors or non-toxic powders during low-volume chemical manipulations by effectively containing low concentrations of noxious fumes, vapors, or powders.
full_description: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is a compact, portable ductless fume adsorber designed to protect users from chemicals, vapors, or non-toxic powders during low-volume chemical manipulations. With a low-profile design, the FUMEBOX can be easily positioned on shallow countertops or under cabinets, providing a clear viewing enclosure to prevent chemical splash. The modular design permits multiple configurations to meet a variety of application needs.
seo_content: The FUMEBOX features a crossflow or upflow airflow design to effectively capture and contain fumes, vapors, and powders. It is constructed with epoxy-coated steel for durability and easy cleaning. The unit meets OSHA standards for occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories and is compliant with ISO 14001 and ISO 9001 quality standards.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood.

Filtration & Airflow.Filter Types: GP Plus!, ACI Plus!/SUL, ACR, ACM, AMM, FOR, HEPA/ULPA

page_content_sections.overview: The Purair® FUMEBOX™ is a compact, portable ductless fume adsorber designed to protect users from chemicals, vapors, or non-toxic powders during low-volume chemical manipulations.
page_content_sections.specifications: The FUMEBOX features epoxy-coated steel construction, meets OSHA standards, and is compliant with ISO 14001 and ISO 9001. It operates on 120V, 60Hz power with a NEMA 5-15P plug.
page_content_sections.applications: The FUMEBOX is suitable for a variety of applications including soldering, histology, cover slipping, staining, pathology, graphic arts, sign shops, art conservation, electronics assembly, particulate control, manufacturing processes, and air purification.
page_content_sections.models: The FUMEBOX is available in three models: AP60H-A (benchtop, horizontal, 21"W), AP60V-A (benchtop, vertical, 21"W), and AP60H-XL-A (benchtop, horizontal, 30"W).
